pages.text: Deep in the stone of Jotunheim lies the dwarves' dark iron ore. It needs an iron pickaxe; smelt the raw metal into ingots. They make the toughest weapons, tools and armour.
In the rift of Muspelheim, embers smoulder in the stone. In a furnace they burn three times as long as coal, and valkyries prize them as trophies.
